text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Right. I was in the middle of the pack up
till this
point, and then in the last
stretch...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Do you need something, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I was just a little curious...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's yesterday's scrimmage you're
watching on
the computer, right? The
one you ran in with
Opera O?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: YAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(My legs feel so heavy! I can't... make
it...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She won, while I lost my speed in
the latter
half and finished sixth. She
utterly defeated me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But I won't lose next time... I can't.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You're so strong...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I was in a different race that day, and
just like
you, I came in sixth... But I
haven't managed to
get back on my
feet.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But instead of letting this loss stop you,
you're
still working hard and moving
forward.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
How did you get to be as strong as you
are?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm not strong. I'm just... determined.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have a goal that I must accomplish no
matter
what, so I can't afford to stop in
my tracks, even
if I lose or am in bad
shape.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
In the past, people used to look up at
the stars
with longing. But years of work
have made it
possible to fly among them
in space nowadays.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So long as you keep marching forward,
you'll be
able to reach the stars one day,
just like the
people who held fast to
their convictions.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Do you have something like that too?
Something
you can't give up on?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I can't lose! For you, my other half—my
sister... I
have to—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega takes the win by a huge
margin!
What an impressive turnaround
from her last race!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your victory, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I agree. You looked like a shooting star
flashing
through the night sky, bright
and strong...
choice_data_list: That was a fiercely intense run!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win my next race too! One
day, I'm
going to shine as brightly as you
and become a
real hero!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.
